title: Finding the Equation of a Parabola
body: A parabola has x-intercepts at $x = -2$ and $x = 4$, and passes through the point $(1, -9)$.\n\nDetermine the equation of the parabola in the form $y = a(x - p)(x - q)$, then expand to standard form.
